about: yt-dlp and YouTube answers recorded on 2026-10-16 with the yt-dlp_linux standalone binary 2026.08.19 and deno 2.9.7. Recorded lookups are scrubbed: the ip and fvip query parameters and any addresses removed, thumbnails, heatmap, description, tags, fragments and most automatic caption languages dropped.

fixtures.note: YouTube asked for a sign-in after a burst of lookups from one address. -J prints null on stdout when the lookup fails.

fixtures.name: flat_listing
fixtures.note: Written by hand in yt-dlp's flat playlist shape (yt_dlp/extractor/youtube/_tab.py, _extract_video), not recorded, since no live lookups were allowed. timestamp is filled only with approximate_date.

Playlist pages show no upload time, so timestamp stays null. A private video keeps its place with the title [Private video] and no channel.

fixtures.note: Written by hand in yt-dlp's flat shape for a channel search tab (yt_dlp/extractor/youtube/_tab.py: the Search tab test for /c/3blue1brown/search?query=..., _extract_video for videoRenderer entries, a playlistRenderer result as a YoutubeTab url), not recorded, since no live lookups were allowed. Search results show '2 years ago', so timestamp is filled with approximate_date. The reaction from another channel checks that only the channel's own uploads are kept.

fixtures.name: lookup_film_1080p
fixtures.note: Recorded lookup of a Goldmines film. Offers 137 (1080p H.264) and 140 (AAC) as plain https formats, only from the visionos client. Stream URLs are expired and bound to the recording address.

fixtures.name: lookup_dubbed_audio
fixtures.note: Recorded lookup of Tere Bin Episode 01 on HAR PAL GEO (2026-10-16). YouTube added auto dubbed audio, so every audio format carries a track suffix (140-0 to 140-11, 139-N, 249-N to 251-N) and no plain 140 exists. 140-11 is the original track (language_preference 10). Only plain https formats kept, URLs cut to expire, itag and size parameters, captions dropped.

fixtures.name: lookup_episode_no_1080p
fixtures.note: Recorded lookup of an ARY episode that succeeded but topped out at 324p (format 134, H.264). No 137, 136 or 135, so Tubarr has no format to serve. Earlier the same video offered 137.
